title: Best Laundry Detergent from Top Stores

paragraphs.paragraph: Laundry detergents on this page are priced from $12.98 up to $43.00. The selection includes scented blends, fragrance-free formulas, concentrated liquids, and specialty washes for activewear or delicate fabrics. Brands use natural extracts like lavender, chamomile, and citrus, as well as enzyme-rich formulas for deep cleaning.

paragraphs.paragraph: When selecting a detergent think about your washing habits. Concentrated liquids are cost-effective and work well in high-efficiency machines. Fragrance-free options are ideal for sensitive skin, while scented varieties add a fresh scent to linens. Some formulas are tailored for activewear, helping to remove sweat and odor without damaging performance fabrics.
paragraphs.replacement: Compare bottle size with the stated number of loads and recommended dose for your usual load size. A concentrate is not automatically cheaper per wash; use the same dosing basis when comparing prices. Check washer compatibility and garment care instructions, and compare fragrance-free and scented options according to your preferences.

faq.question: Can I use a high-efficiency detergent in a regular washer?
faq.answer: Yes, high-efficiency detergents are low-sudsing and safe for both HE and standard machines.
faq.expectedAnswer: Check whether the exact detergent lists your washer type and follow its dose instructions. Where the formula supports both HE and standard machines, the amounts may differ; the HE label alone is not a universal dosing instruction.

faq.question: Do concentrated detergents require less product per load?
faq.answer: They are formulated to be diluted, so you typically use half the amount of a standard liquid detergent.
faq.expectedAnswer: Follow the specific formula’s directions for your load size and washer. There is no universal half-dose rule, and do not pre-dilute unless the directions say to. For value comparisons, use the stated loads at that dose rather than comparing bottle volume alone.
